say:1:1423178001:1.text: I only found out recently that our ancestors during the Ironheart Dominion's era used arcane steel as well!
say:1:1423178001:1.source_cn: 我也是最近才知道，帝国时期的矮人用的也是魔钢！

say:2:1423178002:0.text: They called it "brimstone steel," which is how our village got its name!
say:2:1423178002:0.source_cn: 他们把魔钢叫做深岩钢，这才是深岩村名字的真正由来！

say:3:1423178003:1.text: After so many twists and turns, we dwarves are going back to our old ways...
say:3:1423178003:1.source_cn: 兜兜转转，我们矮人又回到之前的路上了……
